event.canonical_title: North Korea Launches Missile Ahead of US-South Korea Military Exercises
event.summary: North Korea has launched a suspected ballistic missile towards the sea, reportedly falling just outside Japan's special economic zone. This test comes in advance of upcoming military drills between the United States and South Korea.

timeline.title: North Korea Launches Up to 10 Ballistic Missiles Amid U.S.-South Korea Military Drills
timeline.summary: North Korea has launched more than 10 short-range ballistic missiles into the sea, coinciding with President Trump's announcement of scaled-back military drills with South Korea. The South Korean presidential office condemned the missile launches and ordered military readiness during ongoing joint exercises with the US Reports indicate that the missiles landed outside Japan's exclusive economic zone.
key_facts: North Korea fired over 10 short-range ballistic missiles.
The launches occurred shortly after Trump announced reduced military drills with South Korea.
South Korea condemned the missile launches and ordered military readiness.
